title: baseline: ParsedSession::is_password_pending (bool read in Devices page and session box)
trigger: Devices page lists sessions; each row, the details box and the terminate confirm branch on s.is_password_pending (security/mod.rs:137,142; session_list.rs:87,332,393)
effect: No bug today: TDLib reports it as a fact of the session; the split into current / incomplete login / other is rebuilt by hand in three places
fix: Parse once into a SessionKind enum { Current, IncompleteLogin, Other } so the page, box and confirm match one value

title: AgentPageUi::reset_confirm is a dialog-open bool (stage flag named to dodge the word list), cleared by hand at five sites
trigger: Open Settings > Agent access > Reset token, then turn the master switch off (and on), lock, or close the dialog by Esc
effect: No bug today: agent_reset_open() also checks access::enabled() and close_agent_boxes_for_access_off() clears it; but the box state is a bool reset in agent_dialogs.rs (x3), agent_access.rs and close_agent_boxes_for_access_off, beside the consent Option that is the same kind of box
fix: one AgentBox enum { None, Consent(AllChatsConsent), ResetToken } on AgentUi, replaced whole on close/access-off

title: kit dialog shown per window is tracked by three hand-synced writers
trigger: QuillShell::open_dialog is set by sync_host_dialogs, cleared by on_close_kind, and also cleared when main_window.dialogs_closed.take(window_id) was marked by close_kit_dialog_if_done; windows.dialogs_shown_by/dialog_closed_in is a fourth record of the same fact
effect: No bug today (each path is guarded and the comments name the double-close it prevents), but a new close path that forgets the mark would close whichever dialog is on top
fix: One per-window ShownDialog enum { None, Open(DialogKind) } owned by the WindowSlot, with close_kit_dialog_if_done and on_close_kind both moving it, replacing the dialogs_closed side channel

title: TileState::Building holds no task: the build runs in a detached cx.spawn
trigger: A window paints a media spoiler (claims Idle to Building); the app shuts down or the background build never answers
effect: Nothing visible today (the answer always lands while the app runs); but the stage names a build whose task is .detach()ed, so nothing can cancel it or end Building
fix: Building { _build: Task<()> } held in the thread-local, so replacing or dropping the tile cancels the build

title: StickerSetBoxUi keeps one editing flow as five fields reset by hand: pick, pending, create, encoding, reordering
trigger: Open the set box, pick an existing sticker or video, create a sticker, press Done on a video, then switch set or close
effect: No bug today: reset(), claim_sticker_set_box, pick_existing_sticker and pick_video_for_set each clear several of these by hand (pick = None; pending = None); a new flow that forgets one leaves a chooser, a pending download or a create box over the wrong set
fix: one enum SetEditing { Idle, Reordering, Picking(PickExisting), Waiting(PickWait), Creating{create, encoding} } replaced whole by reset()

title: finish_manager clears the box's removals and order before the commit is known to have gone out
trigger: Mark sets removed or drag a new order in Manage sticker sets, then close the box while the commit send fails (commit_sticker_manager returns Err)
effect: The box is already closed and its edits are gone, so the user sees the error toast and must redo every removal and reorder
fix: clear the edits only after commit_sticker_manager returns Ok, or keep them in the session's manager state until the answer lands

title: StoryViewerUi::menu_open is a bool that mirrors the kit menu's visibility by hand
trigger: Open the story's three-dot menu, then close it in a way that skips on_open_change (the trigger is rebuilt for another story, a panel replaces it)
effect: No bug today: leave_item and drop_viewer_ui rebuild the whole StoryViewerUi, so the flag cannot outlive a story; but story_playback_paused reads it, so a stuck true would freeze the story
fix: derive the pause from the kit menu's own open state, or hold it in the ViewerPanel enum as a Menu variant that every panel change replaces

title: StealthStage::Activating has no way out when its request is dropped without a refusal
trigger: Open the stealth box, press Activate; the request is lost (client restart, dropped continuation) and no stealth_refusal or active mode ever arrives
effect: The box button stays on Wait (press() gets activating = true) with no error, until the user closes the box; the story composer stage has an arm for a request that is gone (story_request_pending), this one does not
fix: in drain_story_stealth, leave Activating when session.requests no longer has the request (and no refusal matches): to Failed(generic) so the button asks again

title: A getUserFullInfo error is kept as asked for good, so that user's video userpic is never asked again
trigger: A Premium user's row draws while TDLib answers getUserFullInfo with an error (flood wait, offline blip): `userpic_full_info_asked` keeps (user, photo) and `release_userpic_full_info_ask` runs only on a failed send
effect: The chat list and history keep that user's still userpic for the session unless their profile is opened; the set also grows by one entry per user and photo
fix: Fetch<()> per (user, photo) held in the users state: an error answer is Failed with a retry after a delay, and the set is bounded by the owner

title: State::sweep_due is a hand-cleared stage flag for the deferred sweep, next to the timer task
trigger: begin_render sets sweep_due and defers a closure that clears it by hand with `videos.with(..)`; if that borrow ever fails the clear is lost
effect: No later pass schedules a sweep (`defer = !replace(sweep_due, true)` stays false), so userpic players stop being paused and put to sleep until the app restarts; nothing today borrows the state across that deferred closure
fix: enum Sweep { Idle, Deferred, Armed { _timer: Task<()> } } replaced whole by the sweep itself, so a failed borrow cannot leave the flag set

title: StillCut::Cutting and EditorStage::Encoding name a running worker whose task is .detach()ed, not held in the stage
trigger: Open the video editor, drag the cover (cut starts) or press Done (encode starts), then the scoped app handle stops answering (screen replaced) before the worker returns
effect: The stage stays Cutting/Encoding for the dialog's life: later cover cuts only queue `next` and never run, or the editor stays busy with Done greyed; answers are matched by a token/serial, not by owning the task
fix: StillCut::Cutting { token, next, _task: Task<()> } and EditorStage::Encoding { serial, _job: Task<()> } so leaving the stage cancels the worker (Reading already holds its probe)
